title: paperless-ngx/paperless-ngx
title_zh: 开源文档管理系统 Paperless-ngx

paragraphs.en: A community-supported supercharged document management system: scan, index and archive all your documents
paragraphs.zh: 一个由社区支持的功能强大的文档管理系统：扫描、索引并归档您的所有文档

paragraphs.en: Paperless-ngx is a document management system that transforms your physical documents into a searchable online archive so you can keep, well, less paper .
paragraphs.zh: Paperless-ngx 是一个文档管理系统，它可以将你的纸质文档转换为可搜索的在线档案，这样你就可以少留一些纸张了。

paragraphs.en: Paperless-ngx is the official successor to the original Paperless & Paperless-ng projects and is designed to distribute the responsibility of advancing and supporting the project among a team of people. Consider joining us!
paragraphs.zh: Paperless-ngx 是最初的 Paperless 与 Paperless-ng 项目的官方继任者，旨在将推进和支持该项目的责任分散到一组人的身上。欢迎加入我们！

paragraphs.en: Thanks to the generous folks at Fyra Stack , a demo is available at demo.paperless-ngx.com using login demo / demo . Note: demo content is reset frequently and confidential information should not be uploaded.
paragraphs.zh: 感谢 Fyra Stack 的慷慨人士，演示地址为 demo.paperless-ngx.com，登录账号为 demo / demo。 注意：演示内容会频繁重置，请勿上传机密信息。

paragraphs.en: A full list of features and screenshots are available in the documentation .
paragraphs.zh: 完整的特性列表和截图可在文档中查看。

paragraphs.en: The easiest way to deploy paperless is docker compose . The files in the /docker/compose directory are configured to pull the image from the GitHub container registry.
paragraphs.zh: 部署 paperless 最简单的方法是使用 docker compose。 /docker/compose 目录中的文件已配置为从 GitHub 容器仓库拉取镜像。

sents.en: The easiest way to deploy paperless is docker compose .
sents.zh: 部署 paperless 最简单的方法是使用 docker compose。

sents.en: The files in the /docker/compose directory are configured to pull the image from the GitHub container registry.
sents.zh: /docker/compose 目录中的文件已配置为从 GitHub 容器仓库拉取镜像。

paragraphs.en: If you'd like to jump right in, you can configure a docker compose environment with our install script:
paragraphs.zh: 如果您想直接开始，可以使用我们的安装脚本配置一个 docker compose 环境：

paragraphs.en: bash -c " $( curl -L https://raw.githubusercontent.com/paperless-ngx/paperless-ngx/main/install-paperless-ngx.sh ) " More details and step-by-step guides for alternative installation methods can be found in the documentation .
paragraphs.zh: bash -c " $( curl -L https://raw.githubusercontent.com/paperless-ngx/paperless-ngx/main/install-paperless-ngx.sh ) " 更多详细信息以及替代安装方法的分步指南，请参阅文档。

paragraphs.en: Migrating from Paperless-ng is easy, just drop in the new docker image! See the documentation on migrating for more details.
paragraphs.zh: 从 Paperless-ng 迁移非常简单，只需换上新的 docker 镜像即可！ 更多细节请参阅迁移相关文档。

paragraphs.en: The documentation for Paperless-ngx is available at https://docs.paperless-ngx.com .
paragraphs.zh: Paperless-ngx 的文档可在 https://docs.paperless-ngx.com 获取。

paragraphs.en: If you feel like contributing to the project, please do! Bug fixes, enhancements, visual fixes etc. are always welcome. If you want to implement something big: Please start a discussion about that! The documentation has some basic information on how to get started.

paragraphs.en: Paperless-ngx is available in many languages that are coordinated on Crowdin. If you want to help out by translating paperless-ngx into your language, please head over to https://crowdin.com/project/paperless-ngx , and thank you! More details can be found in CONTRIBUTING.md .
paragraphs.zh: Paperless-ngx 支持多种语言，这些语言的翻译工作通过 Crowdin 协调完成。 如果你想帮忙把 paperless-ngx 翻译成你的语言，请前往 https://crowdin.com/project/paperless-ngx ，谢谢！ 更多详情请参见 CONTRIBUTING.md 。

paragraphs.en: Feature requests can be submitted via GitHub Discussions , you can search for existing ideas, add your own and vote for the ones you care about.
paragraphs.zh: 功能请求可以通过 GitHub Discussions 提交，你可以搜索已有的想法、添加自己的想法，并为你关心的想法投票。

paragraphs.en: For bugs please open an issue or start a discussion if you have questions.
paragraphs.zh: 如有错误（bug），请提交 issue；如有疑问，请发起讨论。

paragraphs.en: Please see the wiki for a user-maintained list of related projects and software that is compatible with Paperless-ngx.
paragraphs.zh: 请查看 wiki，其中包含用户维护的与 Paperless-ngx 兼容的相关项目和软件列表。

paragraphs.en: Document scanners are typically used to scan sensitive documents like your social insurance number, tax records, invoices, etc. Paperless-ngx should never be run on an untrusted host because information is stored in clear text without encryption. No guarantees are made regarding security (but we do try!) and you use the app at your own risk. The safest way to run Paperless-ngx is on a local server in your own home with backups in place .
paragraphs.zh: 文档扫描仪通常用于扫描敏感文件，例如您的社会保险号、税务记录、发票等。 Paperless-ngx 绝不应在不受信任的主机上运行，因为信息以明文形式存储，未经加密。 对于安全性不作任何保证（但我们确实在努力！），使用本应用的风险由您自行承担。 运行 Paperless-ngx 最安全的方式是在您自己家中的本地服务器上运行，并做好备份。
